dialog.title: Family members
dialog.description: Let someone in your family follow this booking: an adult child, a parent, a partner. {helper} will see who follows.
dialog.sees: They'll see the booking's status and time, {helper}'s profile, and your conversation as you see it, with its updates.
dialog.cant: They can't send messages, pay, change or cancel anything, and never see your address or payments.
dialog.removed: {name} doesn't follow this booking any more.
dialog.label: Their username or email
dialog.hint: They need a TasksNearMe account. We'll let them know you added them.
dialog.added: Added {who}. They can follow this booking now.

blocked.limit: {max} people follow this booking: the most it can have. Remove one to add someone else.
blocked.ended: This booking is over, so no one new can follow it.
blocked.series: Regular visits can't be followed yet.

errors.invalid: Enter a username (like @maya) or an email address.
errors.notFound: We couldn't find a TasksNearMe account with that username or email. Ask them to sign up first.
errors.notAllowed: That person can't follow this booking.
errors.limit: {max} people follow this booking already. Remove one first.
errors.expired: This booking is over, so no one new can follow it.

card.title: Family members
card.empty: Let a family member follow this booking. They can read along but can't change anything, and {helper} will see who follows.

note.client: {names} {count, plural, one {follows} other {follow}} this booking as your family. They can read along, and your helper sees this too.
note.helper: {client}'s family {count, plural, one {member} other {members}} {names} {count, plural, one {follows} other {follow}} this booking. They can read the conversation but can't write in it.
note.following: You're following {client}'s booking (read-only). {client}'s messages are on the right.

followed.intro: You're following {client}'s booking, with {helper} helping. You can read along; only the two of them can change it.
followed.ended: Following has ended: this booking with {client} is over.
followed.addressPrivate: The exact address stays between {client} and the helper.

conversation.title: The conversation
conversation.body: Read what {client} and {helper} write to each other. You can't write in it.
